svg.title: dsh-rfq-compare comparison chain
svg.desc: CSV and JSON quotes enter rfq.ingest, normalize to integer cents, rank into a material by supplier score matrix, carry three advisory anomaly flags, then rfq.export writes a local CSV with sha256.
